 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0012
 Paul Long, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
10-13-24
Counsel for defendant:
Richard Marshall, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition, and demands strict proof thereof
as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure. Pursuant to Rule 92, Defendant generally denies the allegations
and requests that Plaintiff be required to prove the charges and allegations against Defendant by a preponderance of
the evidence.
For further answer, and without assuming any burden of proof that would otherwise rest with Plaintiff, Defendant
asserts the following affirmative defenses.
First, Plaintiff's own negligence proximately caused or contributed to the occurrence in question. Under Chapter 33 of
the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code, any recovery must be reduced by the percentage of responsibility
attributed to Plaintiff, and Plaintfif is barred from recovery if that percentage exceeds fifty percent.
Second, the injuries and damages claimed were caused, in whole or in part, by a sudden emergency or by the acts or
omissions of persons other than Defendant, including responsible third parties, and Defendant reserves the right to
designate such persons under Section 33.004.
Third, Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by not following reasonable medical advice or by failing to seek timely and
appropriate treatment, and any recovery must be reduced accordingly.
Defendant reserves the right to amend this answer as discovery proceeds.
</page>

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
